description: This Java class, CategoryController, functions as a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing category-related operations in the web administration interface. It handles displaying, creating, editing, saving, deleting, moving, and paginating categories within an e-commerce platform, utilizing annotations for request mappings and security roles.

classes.name: CategoryController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling CRUD and hierarchy operations for product categories in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayCategoryEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the editing page for an existing category identified by its ID.

methods.name: displayCategoryCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the category creation page.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Internal method to prepare model data for category create/edit pages, setting descriptions, menu, and category details.

methods.name: saveCategory
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new or existing category, including validation, setting descriptions, parent category adjustment, and persistence.

methods.name: displayCategories
methods.description: Handles GET request to show the main categories page, primarily setting up the menu.

methods.name: pageCategories
methods.description: Processes POST request to fetch paginated category data in JSON format, supporting search by name.

methods.name: displayCategoryHierarchy
methods.description: Displays the hierarchical view of categories.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category based on provided categoryId if authorized.

methods.name: moveCategory
methods.description: Moves a category to a new parent, adjusting its hierarchy position.

methods.name: checkCategoryCode
methods.description: Validates whether a category code is already in use within the store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set up menu-related attributes in the model.
